assign.outcome:
**31 pages measured at 5 widths, 1846 spacing findings, evidence only — nothing fixed.** Nine `/imagine/` realms (landing + first 2 children) plus the owner's named `/imagine/paging/toolbars/` group (landing + top/left/right/bottom): [`findings.json`](findings.json) (schema-matched for the merge) · [`shots/before/`](shots/before/) — 31 downscaled 3440 shots + 10 crops for the worst findings, all under budget · full 5-width shot set in the scratchpad. Script: `spacing-audit-a.mjs` (reusable, takes `before`/`after`).

**Headline: 24 of 30 measurable pages (80%) grow spacing less than 1.3x from 1280 to 3440, though the viewport grows 2.69x** — median growth 1.2x across all pages, matching the owner's 'ALL TOO CRAMPED' complaint directly. Worst single findings: `paging/mechanisms/` a 8.3x gap jump next to nothing that explains it (A-79), `codrops/grid-hover/` 7.2x (A-206), three `codrops/line-hover/` link 'strips' 9-12x wider than their own content (A-212/214/216). `platform/existing/` is the one page whose spacing actually *shrinks* at 3440 (0.37x).

**A live collision, disclosed:** mid-run, an unrelated agent's in-progress rebuild of `/imagine/paging/paging.js` deleted the toolbars/top|left|right|bottom `page.js` files and briefly 404'd all five toolbars urls (HTTP 200 client-side error page, so it silently passed the naive ok-check). Caught it, waited for the rebuild to stabilize, recaptured all five clean, and hardened the script to detect this 'Page Load Error' condition for the after round. **Caveat that matters for the judge:** the recovered `toolbars/page.js` now carries a comment saying the rebuild directly answers the owner's own strip complaint — my before numbers for that one group (zero strip findings, all widest_strip:null) may already be the *fixed* design, not the cramped one the owner saw. The other 30 pages are untouched by that rebuild.

**Left for the judge's read, not silently dropped:** `/imagine/design/journey/` is a legitimate 451-thumbnail site-crawl wall — it alone contributes 952 of the 1846 findings (mostly padding-thin/touching on tiny repeating cards); real data, but not comparable density to a normal content page. `padding-thin` (1453 of 1846 findings) fires on every bare inline text link exactly as the brief's rule specifies — most of that volume is ordinary hyperlinks in prose where 0 padding is correct, not a chip/button; the rule as written doesn't distinguish them. `/imagine/review/` declares only one child (`rethink`), not two.

log.msg: AFTER round: 31 pages, 1876 findings (was 1846). By kind before->after: ratio 47->36, strip 62->19 (big win), no-growth 25->25 (unchanged), padding-thin 1453->1425, x0 19->26, touching 146->143, padding-inversion 87->198, padding-fat 7->4.

CAVEAT on padding-inversion 87->198 and x0 19->26: NOT a real regression. The concurrent /imagine/paging/ rebuild (same incident as before-round) renamed that subtrees own page class (page--paging -> paging-app, no .columns ancestor), which breaks this scripts page-gutter probe (returns 0) and rootRect fallback there only. 197 of 198 padding-inversion and 7 of 7 new x0 findings are on paging/examples/mechanisms/toolbars pages specifically - a measurement artifact from an unrelated rebuild finishing between rounds, not the CSS ruling.

REAL finding, plainly worse: /imagine/paging/toolbars/top/ and /bottom/ growth regressed 1.63x -> 0.84x (passed the 1.3x growth test before, now shrinks instead of growing at 3440). /imagine/team/ada/ and /iver/ also got more inverted (0.9x -> 0.72x). Median growth held flat at 1.2x overall - the core cramped-at-3440 complaint is not resolved by this fix even though strip/link-padding improved a lot.

Real wins: strip findings 62->19, all 4 codrops/line-hover link-strips in the original top-10 now hug their content exactly (ratio 1.0x, was 9-15x). codrops/grid-hover/ and codrops/line-hover/ and platform/ and game/ growth improved past 1.3x.
